citation.description: End-to-end test `test_runaway_routes_into_bounded_recovery` asserts result.status=="succeeded" and verdict=="PASS" after RunawayToolLoopError; `test_runaway_double_failure_sidecar_names_the_runaway` asserts terminal state is never a bare LLMError with diagnostic: null

criteria.criterion: a runaway tool-call cycle in the completion gate's verify step is detected DURING the run, aborted at that point, and routed to a verdict built from fresh per-criterion evidence — never a bare `LLMError` with `diagnostic: null`; checked by the actuator child's end-to-end test

citation.description: `test_steering_keeps_tool_definitions_advertised_past_the_limit` asserts all(n > 0 for n in surfaces) — every request's tool surface is non-empty for the whole run; fix in src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py replaces .filtered() with steering wrapper

criteria.criterion: no code path empties the advertised tool surface mid-run after a tool call has occurred, so the Bedrock/Anthropic toolConfig 400 cannot recur; checked by a regression test asserting tool definitions persist for the whole run

citation.description: Tests assert repetition counters (aggregate_tool_calls_distinct, aggregate_max_consecutive_repeat, aggregate_distinct_ratio_window, aggregate_top_repeated_tool_calls) survive onto failure_diagnostic; gate_error_v1 sidecar is emitted; loop vs breadth distinguishable via distinct_ratio_window and max_consecutive_repeat

criteria.criterion: every budget exhaustion or runaway leaves an operator-actionable diagnostic (a `gate_error_v1` sidecar carrying the repetition counters) distinguishing "it looped" from "it ran out of room"; checked by the diagnostic child's sidecar test

citation.description: 12 tests covering: tool_calls written on failure and success paths, loop-vs-breadth separable from record alone (test_a_loop_and_a_breadth_run_are_separable_from_the_record_alone), gate-default sink with no env var, run shape section in summarize output; _SHAPE_FIELDS in usage_log.py and _merge_success_run_shape in runner.py implement durable recording

criteria.criterion: gate runs record request and tool-call usage durably by default, including the loop-vs-breadth axis; checked by the instrumentation child's tests

citation.description: `test_healthy_full_profile_is_never_aborted` and `test_healthy_run_past_flat_landing_threshold_is_never_aborted` assert result=="landed" and counter matches expected; healthy profile min w24 ratio ~0.833 is well above REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50; single-sourcing pin tests confirm guard reads constants from usage_log

criteria.criterion: a healthy high-breadth run is never truncated or aborted by any of the above — budgets remain failure bounds, not workload ceilings; checked by tests replaying the healthy-run profile (0.922 distinct ratio, minimum 24-window ratio 0.833) and asserting no abort
